$comment: Kenney's space-kit rover, conformed like every other vendored asset. Fit to 1.4 m tall so the seat eye points (1.55 m, GDD 'Rover seats') clear the hull -- riders sit above an open buggy, and seated bodies are not rendered anyway. Mount positions are the GDD seat_eye rows in the art frame: the 180-degree-Y flip, (x,y,z) -> (-x,y,-z), same convention as ship.v1. Forward is -Z in the art frame like the astronaut; the model reads near-symmetric fore/aft, so if a render check shows it driving backwards, fix it with yaw here, not in code.
author: Kenney
